capability.title: Bound Capabilities
capability.help: Bind plugins to this route or cluster to enable rate limiting, WAF protection, circuit breaking, retry, and more. Bound plugins take effect within this scope.
capability.emptyHint: Click the button below to add plugin capabilities to this scope.
capability.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the '{pluginId}' capability binding?
capability.schemaParseFailed: Unable to parse plugin configuration schema
capability.modal.pluginDisabledWarning: This plugin is currently disabled globally. Enabling this binding will have no effect.
capability.modal.noSchema: This plugin does not provide a visual configuration schema. Use JSON mode instead.
capability.modal.selectPluginHint: Click a plugin card to bind it to this scope
capability.form.noEditableFields: This plugin has no visual config fields. Use the binding toggle to enable or disable it, or edit via JSON mode.
schema.rate-limit.permitLimit.desc: Maximum requests allowed within the time window
schema.rate-limit.queueLimit.desc: Requests allowed to queue beyond the limit; 0 rejects immediately
schema.rate-limit.partitionKey.desc: Dimension by which rate limiting is applied independently
schema.rate-limit.segmentsPerWindow.desc: Time segments used by the sliding window algorithm
schema.rate-limit.tokenLimit.desc: Maximum tokens the bucket can hold
schema.waf.ipWhitelist.desc: IPs exempt from checks, one per line
schema.waf.ipBlacklist.desc: IPs to block, one per line
schema.waf.maxRequestBodySize.desc: Requests larger than this are rejected
Consecutive failures before the circuit opens
schema.circuit-breaker.recoveryTimeoutSe: How long to wait before entering half-open state
schema.circuit-breaker.failureRatio.desc: Failure ratio that opens the circuit (0-1)
schema.circuit-breaker.minimumThroughput: Requests needed before the failure ratio is evaluated
schema.circuit-breaker.failureStatusCode: Status codes treated as failures, one per line
schema.request-retry.backoffJitterMs.des: Random jitter to avoid retry storms
schema.request-retry.useDifferentDestina: Try other destination nodes in the cluster
Whether to retry non-idempotent requests (e.g. POST)
Status codes that trigger a retry, one per line
schema.response-cache.maxBodyBytes.desc: Responses larger than this are not cached
schema.response-cache.varyByQuery.desc: Different query strings are cached separately
schema.response-cache.varyHeaders.desc: Different values of these headers are cached separately, one per line
schema.response-cache.cacheStatusCodes.d: Only these status codes are cached, one per line
schema.compression.minResponseSize.desc: Responses smaller than this are not compressed
schema.compression.mimeTypes.desc: Only these MIME types are compressed, one per line
schema.service-discovery.staticEndpoints: Target addresses used in static mode, one per line
schema.service-discovery.endpoint.desc: Address of the discovery service (Consul/Nacos, etc.)
How often to refresh the node list
schema.proxy-log.errorsOnly.desc: Only log error responses to reduce volume
schema.fault-injection.enabled.desc: Applies to this route only. Turning this binding off stops the drill immediately and keeps the configuration.
schema.fault-injection.probability.desc: Fraction of matching requests actually affected; 1 means all of them.
schema.fault-injection.delayMinMs.desc: Smallest injected latency; 0 disables the delay.
schema.fault-injection.delayMaxMs.desc: Picked uniformly between the bounds; not above the minimum means a fixed delay.
schema.fault-injection.errorStatusCode.d: Returned instead of forwarding; 0 disables error injection.
schema.fault-injection.errorBody.desc: Empty writes a generic JSON body; a custom body is returned as text/plain.
schema.fault-injection.abortConnection.d: Drops the connection, simulating a transport failure rather than an upstream 5xx. Wins over the status code when both are set.
schema.fault-injection.requiredHeader.de: When set, only requests carrying this header are injected; empty means every request on the route is a candidate.
schema.fault-injection.requiredHeaderVal: Must match exactly when set; empty means any value triggers.
schema.fault-injection.announce.desc: Adds X-Fault-Injected to the response so a drill is not mistaken for an outage.
schema.waf.mode.desc: monitor records hits without blocking, so you can see which real requests a rule set would reject before enforcing it
schema.waf.maxUrlLength.desc: Requests with a longer path are rejected
schema.waf.rules.desc: Empty means the built-in switches below are used. Once populated, this list is the whole inspection pipeline and the switches are ignored
schema.waf.bodyInspection.desc: Only bodies that fit are read whole; larger bodies are skipped rather than partially scanned
schema.waf.response.desc: Status, body and headers returned to the caller when a rule fires
schema.waf.id.desc: Shown in logs and in the X-Waf-Rule response header so a 403 can be traced to one rule
schema.waf.name: Name
schema.waf.tag.desc: Written to the X-Waf-Tag request header when the action is tag
schema.waf.conditions.desc: Alongside a detector, conditions scope it. Without a detector, the conditions are the rule
schema.waf.maxBytes.desc: Larger bodies are not inspected; 0 disables body inspection
schema.waf.contentTypes.desc: Matched as prefixes, so text/ covers every text type. multipart is excluded by default: the envelope is transport metadata, not payload
schema.waf.inspectUnknownContentType.des: With an unknown format there is no way to tell whether it should be read as text, so it is skipped by default
schema.waf.body.desc: Leave empty to return a small JSON document naming the rule that fired
schema.waf.includeRuleHeader: Expose rule id in the response
wafcfg.banner.enforce: Matched requests are rejected with the status code configured under Block response.
wafcfg.banner.monitor: Rules still match and log, but nothing is blocked. Use this to watch for false positives before enforcing.
wafcfg.body.disabled: 0 = do not scan the request body
wafcfg.body.maxHint: Bodies larger than this are skipped whole, never truncated mid-scan
wafcfg.body.off: Off · conditions that read the body will never match
wafcfg.builtin.title: Built-in protection switches
wafcfg.builtin.hint: With an empty rule list, each switch synthesises one built-in rule.
wafcfg.builtin.overridden: The rule list is not empty, so these three switches are not used. They come back only once every rule is removed.
wafcfg.builtin.convertHint: Same behaviour, but now visible and adjustable
wafcfg.builtin.sql-injection: Detects unions, comment truncation and time-delay functions
wafcfg.builtin.xss: Detects <script>, javascript: and inline event handlers
wafcfg.err.emptyRule: {name}: no detector and no conditions, it will be ignored
wafcfg.err.tagMissing: {name}: the action tags the request but no tag is set
wafcfg.err.statusRange: {name}: status code must be between 400 and 599
wafcfg.err.dupId: Rule id {id} is used more than once; the log cannot tell them apart
wafcfg.err.nameMissing: a header or cookie name is required
wafcfg.err.cidr: not a valid address or CIDR block
wafcfg.err.globalStatus: Block response status code must be between 400 and 599
wafcfg.err.bodyMax: Body scanning is on but the limit is 0, so every body is skipped
wafcfg.errors.title: {n} item(s) to fix
wafcfg.note.unscoped: No conditions: applies to every request
wafcfg.note.emptyRule: Neither a detector nor a condition - this rule will be ignored
wafcfg.preamble.title: Preamble checks (IP and size)
wafcfg.preamble.note: These run before every rule. An allow rule cannot bypass them.
wafcfg.rule.enable: Whether this rule takes part in matching
wafcfg.rule.statusInherit: Empty uses the global status code from Block response
wafcfg.rules.empty: No rules yet. Start from a template above, or add a blank rule.
wafcfg.template.label: Quick add
schema.waf.rateLimit.desc: Only used by the throttle action: 429 once one partition exceeds the quota within a window
wafcfg.rule.windowHint: Window length such as 30s, 1m, 1h; the unit is required
wafcfg.err.quotaLimit: {name}: the limit must be greater than 0
wafcfg.err.quotaWindow: {name}: the window must look like 30s, 1m or 1h
wafcfg.err.quotaPartition: {name}: the partition is not one of the supported values
envp.title: Compare and promote
envp.confirmLive: That environment is what the gateway is serving: the change affects live traffic immediately.
capability.modal.applyPresetTitle: Write this preset straight into the current binding
capability.presetDeleteConfirm: Delete preset "{name}"? Bindings that already use it are unaffected.
